title: plugins/<id>/build.json: how the registry builds a plugin's plugin.wasm
description: This repository's own format (not a DeckPilot schema). The source (repository, tag, commit, path) of each version is in registry/plugins/<id>/versions/<version>.json.

toolchain.description: Exact Rust toolchain, installed with rustup.

workspace.description: Directory of the Cargo workspace (with Cargo.lock), relative to the source repository root; "." for the root.

package.description: Cargo package that builds the module (cargo build -p).

profile.description: Cargo profile, e.g. release or guest.

artifact.description: File name of the module under target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/<profile>/.
